A well-established and highly regarded Architecture, Design & Planning firm in Ottawa is seeking an Intermediate Architectural Project Manager
to join its growing team. The firm has a strong and varied project portfolio spanning public, institutional, and private-sector developments.

Excellent organizational and time-management abilities

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

What You Get In Return

Opportunities for professional development and career progression

jobs.description:
Description

Project Manager (eCOA Manager) remote in Argentina

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Job Summary:

Provides customer-focused management of Clinical Surveillance & Training (CST) scoped services to support scientific integrity and data quality in clinical trials.

Duties also include liaising with customers, vendors and/or investigative sites to manage projects start-up to final deliverables to the customer. Upon displaying proficiency, a CST Project Manager II may be awarded the opportunity to function at the CST Sr. Project Manager level.

Core Responsibilities:

Working under the limited guidance and mentorship of the CST Director BU Ops, Management (Line Manager) or designee:
Function as a representative of the Clinical Surveillance & Training (CST) team on small to large-sized studies or programs, interact with other functional groups, vendors, license holders, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and Sponsors. May serve as a Project Lead in CST stand-alone projects and serves as a Functional Lead in full scope or multiple protocol projects.
Manage CST deliverables pertaining to scoped services vendors (i.e., Rater Training vendors), scale license holders and/or KOLs.
Manage all aspects of license procurement, scale translation requirements, and paper scale worksheet development.
Manage creation of all CST service-related documentation and templates. This may include managing development and testing of the CST Study Training and Engagement Portal (STEP) to meet study-specific Rater Training needs.
Manage all aspects of CST services to ensure quality and timely delivery and implementation.

Develop and maintain the study-specific CST plan in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs).
Contribute to relevant functional project plans to ensure alignment with the CST plan.
Provide regular and timely status updates to internal and Sponsor project teams regarding CST scoped services, including risks to delivery such as timeline delays and serve as a central point of contact for CST-related project issues and solicit support from LM or CST SMEs, as required.
Create and maintain CST metric reports for scoped services, for delivery to client.
Attend Trusted Process, internal and Sponsor meetings as a lead CST representative to discuss CST strategy, address CST-related agenda topics, and provide status reports.
Ensure CST project documentation is maintained on an ongoing basis and ensure required documentation is filed completely and accurately in the Trial Master File (TMF).
Identify risks and develop mitigation plan as required.
Participate in Sponsor, internal or agency audits and inspections, as required.
Responsible for management of CST scope, including identification of CST out of scope activities and overburn, including revenue recognition (if delegated this task by study lead or if serving as a Project lead in stand-alone study), invoice management (tracking and confirmation of payment), and/or KOL contract and management, etc. May participate in internal financial review meetings to review CST overburn or financial risk, as needed.
Plan, manage, and request CST resources (e.g., CST Project Specialist, CST Clinical Scientist, CST Assessment Scientist, etc) and provide CST resource updates for assigned projects.
Train and mentor internal team members.

Qualification:

Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) level of qualification in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing or related field equivalent preferred.
Prior experience in study coordination, contract research organization (CRO), pharmaceutical, biotechnology or rater training vendor company preferred.
Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince and persuade.
Good organizational, planning, customer service, and time management skills with the ability to multitask under tight deadlines while providing attention to detail. Ability to manage time and work independently.
High level of competency in English language.
Proficiency with MS Office Applications.
Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/ International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements.
Ability to travel as necessary (up to 25%).

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

jobs.title: Senior Automation Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Role:
Senior Automation Project Manager

Department:
Automation Implementation

Location:
Remote

Employment Type:
Full Time

The Sr. Automation PM independently leads the execution of complex intralogistics and warehouse automation projects from contract handoff through final customer acceptance, closeout, and transition to After Sales Service. This role owns project scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, safety coordination, commercial performance, stakeholder alignment, and customer satisfaction. The Sr. Automation PM provides clear leadership across Engineering, Controls, Software, Purchasing, Installation, Commissioning, Finance, Sales, suppliers, subcontractors, and customer teams to deliver safe, predictable, and commercially successful outcomes.

Overall Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Governance

Lead multiple concurrent automation projects or one highly complex program with full accountability for delivery results.
Create and maintain the project execution plan, governance cadence, responsibility assignments, decision log, action log, and communication plan.
Lead internal kickoff, customer kickoff, recurring project reviews, executive updates, recovery meetings, and lessons learned sessions.
Establish clear priorities, ownership, and due dates across cross functional teams, suppliers, and subcontractors.
Mentor Project Managers and Project Coordinators and provide practical guidance on project controls, customer communication, and issue resolution.
Escalate material risks, missed commitments, and decisions requiring leadership support with facts, impact, options, and a recommended path forward.

Scope, Contract, and Commercial Management

Own the baseline scope and confirm alignment among the customer contract, proposal, specifications, drawings, assumptions, exclusions, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
Identify scope gaps, interface risks, and conflicting requirements before they affect execution.
Maintain disciplined change control, including documentation of scope, cost, schedule, risk, approval status, and customer authorization before work proceeds when contractually required.
Monitor project financial performance, including budget, forecast, commitments, contingency, cash flow, billing milestones, margin exposure, and cost to complete.
Partner with Finance and the Project Coordinator to support accurate and timely invoicing, payment milestone tracking, and project financial reporting.
Monitor contractual obligations, notices, deliverables, warranties, liquidated damages exposure, and acceptance requirements in coordination with leadership and appropriate business partners.
Support commercial negotiations and claims with complete records, objective impact analysis, and clear recommendations.

Schedule and Resource Management

Develop, baseline, and maintain an integrated project schedule covering design, approvals, procurement, fabrication, delivery, installation, controls, software, testing, training, commissioning, acceptance, and closeout.
Validate logic, dependencies, critical path, resource needs, customer prerequisites, supplier commitments, and recovery options.
Coordinate resource plans with functional leaders and identify capacity conflicts early.
Measure progress against the approved baseline, document variance, and lead corrective or recovery planning when milestones are at risk.
Provide reliable schedule updates to internal stakeholders, customers, suppliers, and leadership.

Technical Integration and Execution

Coordinate mechanical, electrical, controls, software, information technology, network, equipment, rack, conveyor, robotics, and building interfaces across the complete solution.
Ensure design reviews, submittals, approvals, requirements, interface documents, and working drawings are completed and distributed to the correct stakeholders.
Facilitate clarification of functional requirements, control narratives, software requirements, operating concepts, rate assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
Maintain working knowledge of warehouse automation technologies such as conveyor and sortation, automated storage and retrieval systems, shuttles, automated guided vehicles, autonomous mobile robots, robotics, warehouse control systems, and warehouse execution systems.
Coordinate site readiness, delivery sequencing, installation access, utilities, network availability, customer dependencies, and operational constraints.
Lead integration planning across suppliers so that responsibilities, data exchanges, interfaces, and testing ownership are clear.

Risk, Quality, Safety, and Compliance

Create and maintain the project risk and opportunity register with owners, mitigation actions, due dates, financial exposure, and escalation thresholds.
Lead issue resolution and root cause reviews for significant quality, performance, schedule, and integration problems.
Coordinate project quality planning, inspections, punch lists, nonconformance resolution, documentation, and verification of corrective actions.
Promote a strong safety culture and coordinate with site leadership, customers, suppliers, and subcontractors to confirm applicable safety plans, training, permits, and site requirements are addressed.
Stop or escalate work when unsafe conditions, unapproved scope, or material delivery risks are identified.
Maintain project records in accordance with company requirements and applicable contract obligations.

Installation, Testing, Commissioning, and Acceptance

Coordinate construction and installation activities with the site team, customer, suppliers, and subcontractors.
Lead readiness reviews for installation, power on, controls checkout, software integration, factory testing, site testing, performance testing, training, go live, and acceptance.
Confirm test plans trace to contractual requirements and define prerequisites, responsibilities, evidence, issue handling, and retest expectations.
Manage commissioning priorities, daily constraints, punch items, defect resolution, and customer communication during critical site phases.
Prepare and execute customer acceptance activities and secure required approvals and completion documentation.
Coordinate operational handoff, training, spare parts, as built documentation, warranties, open item ownership, and transition to After Sales Service.

Customer, Supplier, and Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary project management contact for the customer throughout execution.
Build trusted relationships through clear expectations, timely communication, accurate reporting, and consistent follow through.
Lead supplier and subcontractor performance reviews covering scope, schedule, quality, safety, documentation, change control, and corrective actions.
Partner with Purchasing on supplier selection, award support, purchase order alignment, and performance management.
Coordinate with Sales on customer commitments, commercial strategy, account relationships, and future opportunities while protecting approved project scope.
Communicate difficult information directly and professionally while preserving constructive working relationships.

Reporting and Project Controls

Provide concise weekly project updates to internal and external teams and monthly reporting to leadership.
Report overall status, project health, completed work, upcoming milestones, financial outlook, critical path, major risks, decisions, dependencies, changes, customer actions, supplier actions, and leadership attention items.
Maintain accurate schedules, meeting records, action logs, risk registers, decision logs, change logs, forecasts, and document repositories.
Use project data to identify trends, challenge unsupported assumptions, and drive timely decisions.
Ensure project documentation is complete, current, traceable, and ready for customer acceptance, audit, warranty support, and closeout.

Knowledge & Skill Requirements

Five or more years of project management experience delivering material handling, warehouse automation, industrial automation, or other complex engineered systems.
Demonstrated ownership of projects through design, procurement, installation, integration, commissioning, acceptance, and closeout.
Working knowledge of mechanical equipment, electrical systems, controls, software, networks, and system interfaces within an automation environment.
Experience managing contracts, scope, change control, schedules, budgets, forecasts, suppliers, subcontractors, risks, and customer expectations.
Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, contracts, schedules, layouts, and CAD drawings.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint or comparable project platforms.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, conflict resolution, and executive communication skills.
Ability to travel overnight and work outside standard business hours when required by installation, testing, commissioning, or customer operations.
Ability to work effectively in office, remote, warehouse, construction, and active customer operating environments.
Bachelor degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, computer science, construction management, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Project Management Professional certification or comparable project management credential.
Experience acting as a general contractor, systems integrator, or prime supplier on turnkey automation projects.
Experience with conveyor and sortation, automated storage and retrieval systems, shuttles, robotics, automated guided vehicles, autonomous mobile robots, warehouse control systems, or warehouse execution systems.
Experience with schedule recovery, claims support, troubled project stabilization, and executive customer communication.
OSHA 30 training or comparable construction safety training.
Experience coaching Project Managers or leading project teams without direct authority.

Professional Qualities

Ownership: Accepts accountability, follows through, and makes sound decisions.
Commercial Judgment: Balances customer needs, contract obligations, cost, margin, and long term relationships
Structured Execution: Creates practical plans, maintains controls, and converts ambiguity into clear action.
Technical Curiosity: Asks effective questions and understands how system interfaces affect delivery
Communication: Provides clear, factual, audience appropriate updates and escalations
Leadership: Builds alignment, influences without authority, and supports the growth of others
Problem Solving: Uses data, root cause thinking, and options analysis to resolve complex issues
Resilience: Maintains composure, priorities, and professionalism during high pressure project phases

Work Conditions

Frequent computer use, virtual meetings, and extended periods of sitting or standing.
Regular presence in warehouses, construction areas, and customer facilities where personal protective equipment may be required.
Ability to walk active project sites, use stairs, and access work areas consistent with site rules and applicable accommodations.
Occasional evening, weekend, or extended hours during site mobilization, testing, commissioning, go live, or recovery activities.
Regular overnight travel based on project phase and business need

Success Measures

Safe execution and consistent compliance with project and site requirements.
Performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and acceptance commitments.
Accurate forecasting, timely change management, and protection of project financial outcomes.
Early identification and effective mitigation of risks, issues, and dependencies.
Complete project documentation and an orderly handoff to the customer and After Sales Service.
Customer confidence, stakeholder alignment, and clear executive visibility throughout the project lifecycle.

jobs.title: Senior FedRAMP Program Manager
jobs.description:
This is a fully remote opportunity.

As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

The FedRAMP Program Manager serves as the day-to-day owner of the company’s responsibilities within a partner-managed FedRAMP environment. This individual translates FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, assessment, and external-partner requirements into clear internal actions; coordinates evidence and remediation activities across functional teams; manages deadlines and shared-responsibility dependencies; and independently evaluates whether company work, remediation responses, and evidence are sufficiently complete and responsive for submission to external FedRAMP partners, assessors, or other stakeholders. The role works with limited day-to-day supervision under the direction of the Director of Security and Compliance, establishes the operating structure needed to keep the program moving, and provides timely visibility into program status, risks, blockers, and required decisions.

This is an individual-contributor program execution and subject-matter-expert role; it does not perform engineering implementation or technical remediation. Strong performance in this role results in a FedRAMP program that remains organized, assessment-ready, and on schedule, with clear ownership, reliable evidence, timely remediation, and emerging risks addressed before they become compliance blockers.

Job Responsibilities

FedRAMP Program Execution
Own day-to-day execution of the company side of the FedRAMP program, including milestones, dependencies, risks, deadlines, and internal follow-through.
Translate FedRAMP requirements, findings, partner requests, and service-level commitments into clear internal actions with defined owners, due dates, evidence expectations, and acceptance criteria.
Maintain an authoritative view of program status and proactively identify work that may threaten assessment, remediation, continuous-monitoring, or other FedRAMP deadlines.
Assess overall program readiness and proactively identify systemic gaps in controls, evidence, ownership, processes, or dependencies that could jeopardize FedRAMP objectives
Operate independently within established direction by determining required next actions, establishing priorities and deadlines, resolving routine program and ownership issues, and escalating material risks, disputed requirements, risk-acceptance decisions, missed commitments, or matters requiring management, partner, or specialized technical intervention.
Leverage approved AI-enabled tools and automation to improve the efficiency and quality of program activities while independently validating outputs against authoritative requirements and program context

Evidence, Controls, and Remediation Coordination
Coordinate implementation and ongoing operation of organizational and procedural controls retained by the company, including identifying and working with appropriate internal control owners.
Coordinate company inputs into partner-managed FedRAMP records, including control narratives, evidence, remediation information, and other required program documentation.
Collect and review evidence for completeness, accuracy, relevance, currency, traceability to applicable controls or findings, and consistency with documented FedRAMP and partner requirements before submission.
Act as the company-side quality gate for evidence and remediation responses, independently rejecting incomplete or inadequate submissions and requiring correction before external submission while escalating interpretation disputes or questions of external acceptance when appropriate.
Track findings from initial assessments, continuous monitoring, and other authorized testing through assignment, remediation, evidence submission, and closure.
Establish internal remediation deadlines, with management input as appropriate, based on external deadlines, service-level requirements, risk, and program dependencies.

Cross-Functional and Partner Coordination
Serve as the primary operational interface with the company’s external FedRAMP infrastructure and compliance partner.
Participate in partner-led continuous-monitoring meetings and ensure resulting actions, findings, requests, and decisions are communicated, assigned, tracked, and completed internally.
Work closely with Software Engineering and Cloud Engineering to communicate technical compliance requirements, remediation expectations, deadlines, and required evidence without performing the technical remediation directly.
Coordinate with Security, IT, Support, Operations, Product, Legal, and leadership on organizational controls, process changes, customer or contractual considerations, and other FedRAMP-related obligations.
Drive commitments across teams that do not report directly to the role through clear requirements, follow-through, escalation, and accountability.
Engage appropriate technical or functional subject-matter experts when specialized validation is required and ensure their conclusions are reflected in the program record.

Scope, Change, and Program Governance
Maintain clarity over FedRAMP-in-scope users, systems, workflows, integrations, organizational processes, control inheritance, and shared-responsibility boundaries.
Maintain clear understanding of which obligations are retained by the company versus operated, inherited, or evidenced by external partners.
Coordinate review of proposed product, infrastructure, operational, or process changes that may affect FedRAMP scope, documented behavior, or control responsibilities.
Coordinate delivery and maintenance of required compliant system artifacts, including the approved operating-system image, by the teams responsible for engineering and implementation.
Identify gaps or ambiguity in responsibility between the company and external partners and drive resolution before those gaps create compliance or delivery risk.
Recommend program priorities and corrective actions based on FedRAMP requirements, organizational readiness, risk, external dependencies, and authorization objectives
Provide FedRAMP subject-matter input to Product, Legal, and other stakeholders, distinguishing documented requirements from partner preferences, interpretation questions, and internal risk decisions.
Continuously improve FedRAMP processes, documentation, evidence practices, ownership models, and operating routines to create a sustainable and repeatable compliance program

Reporting and Escalation
Provide concise, decision-ready reporting to the Director of Security and Compliance on program status, upcoming deadlines, open findings, remediation progress, evidence quality, partner dependencies, and material risks.
Escalate early when a missed or threatened deadline, disputed requirement, repeated quality failure, unresolved ownership issue, or external dependency requires management or executive intervention.

jobs.description:
Position

Company : Liberty Mutual Insurance

Location : Seattle, Washington

Posted On : 9/21/2026

Description

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Indianapolis, IN; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

Position Summary

Position Summary

The Senior Program Manager, leads enterprise-level enablement efforts that support the execution, adoption, and scale of Liberty Mutuals employee engagement Torchbearers program developing the tools, resources, operating rhythms, and reporting infrastructure that help leaders, employees, and cross-functional partners engage with the program consistently and effectively.

Operating with a high degree of independence, this role partners across Communications, HR, Operations, Data, and Technology to translate enterprise priorities into practical, scalable support mechanisms. Success requires strong program management discipline, sound judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders, create clarity, and drive execution across a matrixed environment advancing the employee engagement experience through strong governance, user-focused resources, and disciplined execution.

Key Responsibilities

Program Enablement and Execution

Lead prioritized enablement workstreams, translating program priorities into sequenced, actionable plans with clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, and outcomes.
Serve as a strategic thought partner on how Torchbearers initiatives are packaged, activated, and operationalized across the enterprise.
Drive day-to-day execution with strong program management rigor, tracking deliverables, dependencies, and timelines across workstreams to ensure commitments are met.
Build repeatable approaches and recommend improvements based on data, feedback, and enterprise needs that strengthen consistency, effectiveness, and scalability.

Self-Service Resources and Governance

Develop and maintain self-service tools, playbooks, templates, guidance documents, FAQs, and job aids that enable efficient, consistent program participation.
Establish standards for the development, maintenance, and governance of Torchbearers enablement assets, ensuring materials are actionable, accessible, current, and fit for purpose across stakeholder groups.
Maintain ownership, version control, and documentation standards for program resources, and support consistent governance, review, and approval processes for Torchbearers materials and deliverables.
Identify opportunities to streamline execution, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational efficiency.

Cross-Functional Partnership, Stakeholder Engagement, and Leadership

Partner with HR, Communications, Operations, Data, Technology, and business stakeholders to ensure Torchbearers is well integrated across the enterprise.
Influence stakeholders at multiple levels to align on execution approach, timing, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Surface issues, constraints, and risks proactively, and drive resolution in a constructive, solutions-oriented manner.
Bring a consultative approach to problem solving and stakeholder management; may coordinate the work of contractors or matrixed partners in support of program deliverables.
Model Liberty values and a high-performance, collaborative mindset in all interactions.

Measurement, Reporting, and Insights

Monitor and maintain metrics, dashboards, and reporting that assess adoption, utilization, effectiveness, and progress against program goals.
Use data, stakeholder feedback, and observed trends to identify opportunities to improve program support and execution.
Develop executive-level updates, recommendations, and narrative reporting that connect program activity to outcomes and enterprise value.
Partner with data and technology teams to ensure information is accurate, actionable, and sustainable.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; 510+ years of experience in program management, operations, enablement, internal consulting, communications, or a related enterprise discipline.
Demonstrated success leading strategic workstreams and building scalable support infrastructure including toolkits, playbooks, operating guides, or self-service resources in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholders independently, and to create leverage through structure, clarity, and repeatable execution.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create concise, executive-level materials and compelling narratives.
Proven ability to influence without authority, build alignment across senior and cross-functional stakeholders, and collaborate and facilitate effectively with leaders, peers, and working teams enterprise-wide.
Strong business acumen and judgment, with the ability to connect execution detail to broader enterprise priorities.
Ability to use data, dashboards, and feedback to improve adoption, effectiveness, and decision-making.
Demonstrated curiosity and experience with GenAI, digital tools, automation, or other innovations that improve operational efficiency, communications quality, and impact.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in enterprise program enablement, internal operations, communications operations, or shared services within a large organization, supporting enterprise-wide initiatives with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.
Familiarity with change management, governance frameworks, and adoption strategies.
Experience developing resources or operating support for employee-facing, leader-facing, or enterprise program experiences, using platforms for knowledge management, content governance, workflow tracking, or program administration.

About Us

Pay Philosophy:
The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://LMI.co/Benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. Description

Amazon’s Unified Alternate Fulfillment channel (UAF) team is looking for an experienced Program Manager for regional program management across Africa, Middle East and Turkey (MEATR region) to expand the network of Seller Flex, Vendor Flex and Direct fulfillment channels.

Our Program Managers are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. As a Program Manager, the mission will be to pioneer new ways of thinking, designing and delivering exceptional results. By collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis with an eye on the long-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

Program management and data analysis skills, ability to conduct deep dive analyses, and strong stakeholder management skills.
Attention to detail and effective communication with diverse stakeholders.
Create innovative solutions using data and research to address wider challenges in your organization.
Take a big-picture approach in your analysis of business operations, driving improvements across a range of teams and organizations.
Work alongside senior leadership to establish and prioritize improvement programs, seeing them through from start to finish.
Enhance operational performance on every program in partnership with your stakeholders.

A day in the life

Job Description

The Senior Supply Operations Program Manager
supports the Total InteGrated Engine Revitalization (TIGER) Public Private Partnership (PPP) Program, which includes production, development, and sustainment activities for the AGT1500 engine. This role focuses on hardware and supply operations management, ensuring product affordability, product integrity, and on time deliveries that enable near-, mid-, and long term business growth.

You will collaborate closely with the TIGER Integrated Supply Chain team and act as the primary liaison to Customer Business Management and the Gold Business Enterprise. Success requires leading and influencing across all organizational levels and working directly with internal and external customers.

This role supports parts supply operations for a complex, high value requirements contract that requires flexibility of day-to-day working hours, periodic domestic travel, and local movement between buildings and facilities. The position also includes high visibility with executive leadership as TIGER is a key Honeywell Aerospace program.

You will report directly to our Senior Program Manager, and you’ll work on a Hybrid work schedule (at least three days per week in-office) from our Phoenix, AZ location.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Hardware & Supply Operations Management

Develop and execute hardware ordering, receipt, and delivery plans to meet customer on time delivery commitments.
Manage a high mix environment with frequently shifting priorities.
Track existing and emerging TIGER program part and component requirements .
Serve as the hardware delivery and supply point of contact during proposal development, ensuring cost assumptions and risks are clearly understood.
Own hardware delivery forecasts and revenue projections.

Supply Management

Manage supply performance across cost, quality, schedule, and risk dimensions.
Drive effective Management Operating Systems to ensure on-time deliveries
Generate and execute comprehensive part supply plans.
Oversee variance analysis between expected costs and actuals.
Partner with TIGER Integrated Supply Chain to build strong relationships with key suppliers and coordinate supply expansion and supply resilience efforts as needed .

Program Leadership & Cross Functional Coordination

Ensure adherence to program plans, schedules, and budgets.
Lead and influence cross functional teams across multiple Honeywell Aerospace sites.
Represent customer needs and maintain strong customer relationships.
Support strategic program and operations planning for current and future supply performance.
Coordinate across programs to identify and resolve conflicts in supply requirements.

Reporting & Executive Communication

Prepare and present Monthly Operations Review materials, summarizing program status and supply challenges.
Maintain performance accountability related to margin attainment, working capital health, and unique program requirements.

Qualifications

US PERSON REQUIREMENT:

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.

Must Have

Program management and leadership experience.
Experience supporting USG FAR15 proposal development.
Demonstrated ability to manage cost, schedule, and performance using tools such as EVMS and Risk & Opportunity Management.
Proven ability to lead and influence to drive quality and meet performance goals.

We Value

Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree and 7+ years of experience.
Strong track record in developing relationships with suppliers, customers, government representatives, primes, and internal teams.
Experience monitoring supplier performance and implementing corrective/preventive actions.
Familiarity with Honeywell Aerospace processes and cross functional teams.
Experience with Make/Buy/Where decisions making processes.
Knowledge of Defense Priorities & Allocation System (DPAS) requirements.
Proficiency with MRP systems (such as SAP) and Microsoft Office (Excel and PowerPoint).

Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance

Short-term and long-term disability coverage

401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts

Employee assistance program and educational assistance

Parental leave and 12 paid holidays

Title And Summary

Program Manager, Learning & Development

Overview: The Program Manager, Learning and Development (L&D) is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing L&D programs that support the strategic objectives of the organization.

This role requires a dynamic individual skilled in program management, stakeholder engagement, curriculum design, and process improvement, with a passion for fostering employee development.

The ideal candidate will be adept at managing multiple L&D initiatives simultaneously, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet the needs of the organization.

Role And Responsibilities

Experience Design:

Engage with key stakeholders to gather learning needs, program requirements, timelines, and strategic outcomes.
Lead the design and development of engaging and effective learning programs that address those needs.
Work with Learning Experience Designers to envision and design learning programs that are aligned with strategic objectives, showcase L&D best practices, and are delivered through appropriate learning modalities (e.g., in-person, virtual, e-learning).
Ensure learning programs incorporate feedback and adapt to changing organizational needs.

Program Planning And Execution

Develop comprehensive project plans for L&D programs/initiatives that align with organizational needs, timelines, resources, etc.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including learning designers, delivery specialists, admins, and subject matter experts, to ensure effective and efficient program execution.
Monitor and track program progress, adjusting plans as necessary to meet targets.

Stakeholder Management

Provide updates and ensure alignment with program objectives.
Serve as the primary point of contact for all program-related inquiries and communications, fostering strong relationships with internal and external partners.

Resource Management

Identify and allocate resources necessary for program execution, including budget management and resource scheduling.
Manage program budgets, ensuring financial objectives are met and resources are utilized efficiently.

Risk Management

Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on program delivery.
Monitor and report on program risks, implementing corrective actions as needed.

Quality Assurance

Ensure that all L&D program deliverables meet the required quality standards and specifications.
Implement continuous improvement processes to enhance program performance and outcomes.

Data Analysis And Reporting

Collect and analyze program data to evaluate performance, identify trends, and inform decision-making.
Prepare and present detailed reports on program status, outcomes, and areas for improvement.

Benchmarking And External Insights

Benchmark L&D programs against industry best practices and emerging trends.
Bring external insights and suggestions to enhance the effectiveness and innovation of L&D initiatives.

Process Improvement

Evaluate existing L&D processes and workflows, identifying opportunities for improvement.
Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance program efficiency and effectiveness.

Team Leadership

Provide guidance, support, and leadership to program teams.
Foster a collaborative and high-performance team environment.

Skills And Qualifications

Educational Background:

Advanced degrees or certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PgMP) or L&D (e.g., CPLP) are preferred.

Experience

Proven experience in program or project management, with a track record of successfully delivering complex L&D projects.
Experience in curriculum design and instructional design, creating engaging and effective learning experiences.
Experience managing cross-functional teams and working in a matrix organization.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in project management software and L&D tools (e.g., LMS, monday.com).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
Problem-solving mindset with the ability to think strategically and execute methodically.

Personal Attributes

Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
Adaptable and resilient, able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, WW Operations Finance — Standardization and Automation Team
jobs.description:
Description

Do you thrive at the intersection of technology strategy and large-scale program execution? The WW Operations Finance — Standardization and Automation Team is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the strategic evolution of our financial analytics platforms supporting the Global Customer Fulfillment network. This role requires an AI-native mindset — using Generative AI tools and automation as a core part of how you plan, execute, and deliver.

As a Principal TPM supporting Global Customer Fulfillment Analytics, you will own the program strategy, multi-team execution, and stakeholder alignment for data solutions delivery, LLM-powered reporting workflows, autonomous data pipelines, and scalable platform capabilities across one of Amazon's largest finance organizations. You will orchestrate the transition from legacy systems to a modern data lakehouse architecture, ensuring Finance customers have reliable, performant access to the insights they need. This means navigating interdependent tools and platforms, driving alignment across competing priorities, making high-judgment calls with incomplete information, and adapting roadmaps as new internal products evolve.

Success in this role demands deep technical fluency, strategic leadership, and the ability to influence at scale without direct authority. You will define the multi-year technical roadmap, build frameworks that create organizational clarity across matrixed teams, forge strong partnerships with engineering, product, and finance leadership, and champion emerging technologies — delivering a robust data infrastructure that empowers faster, more informed decision-making across Operations Finance.

Key job responsibilities

Own the lifecycle of large, complex multi-team technology programs from concept through delivery — defining the long-term roadmap for data solutions, intelligent analytics, and platform modernization across WW Operations Finance
Drive consensus among Tech and Finance partners on strategic roadmaps and prioritization; influence the direction of multiple engineering teams and advise Sr. Managers and Directors on program strategy and trade-offs
Work with VP orgs to influence system owners, architecture decisions, and organizational priorities
Lead full-lifecycle program execution for the transition from legacy financial reporting systems to a modern data lakehouse architecture with AI-powered automated workflows
Champion the adoption of Generative AI tools and automation across TPM workflows; drive measurable productivity gains and establish best practices for AI-assisted planning, execution, and reporting
Manage program-level schedules, milestones, risks, and success metrics; resolve bottlenecks and balance competing priorities by leading through persuasion rather than direct authority
Own program communication — drive crisp decisions, clear blockers, escalate appropriately, and present effectively to senior leadership; draft strategic documents (MTR, MBR/QBR, design docs, PR/FAQ, OP1/OP2) that synthesize complex problems into clear narratives
Mentor and develop TPMs and interdisciplinary team members, raising the bar on TPM practices across the organization

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing program metrics and dashboards to identify emerging risks or blockers. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team alignment meeting where engineering leads debate technical trade-offs — your role is to drive the discussion toward a crisp decision. After lunch, you draft a program update narrative for senior leadership, distilling complex technical progress into clear business outcomes. Later, you connect with a partner team to negotiate a dependency timeline and unblock a critical deliverable. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of technical product or program management experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

jobs.title: Technical Infrastructure Program Manager- Material Development, GCID-FD
jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Sep 25, 2026

The Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) organization within AWS deploys all fiber infrastructure globally. We are looking for a TIPM II – Material Development to support in executing this program’s mission. You will own tactical workstreams across the material development pipeline. Driving vendor development timelines, coordinating qualification trials, managing program tracking, and ensuring every material in the pipeline moves efficiently through gates toward global deployment. You’ll work at the intersection of product development, supply chain, and field engineering, helping AWS introduce materials that solve real deployment challenges created by next-generation fabric architectures.

Key job responsibilities

Own day-to-day tracking of materials through lifecycle to ensure tasks clear gates on schedule

Manufacturer Development Coordination - Manage tactical development timelines with vendor R&D partners; track milestones, document action items.

Qualification & Testing Programs - Coordinate field trials end-to-end: develop test plans, manage sample logistics and lab scheduling, attend field deployments with vendors, validate runbooks, and compile Post-Test Findings reports against defined success criteria

Prototype Management - Support RFQ processes, track vendor build progress, coordinate lab-based Initial Validation, and document Go/No-Go decisions

Documentation & Force Multiplication - Create and maintain standardized templates, runbooks, evaluation rubrics, and document libraries

Cross-functional Coordination - Work across procurement, standards, quality assurance, fiber engineering, and field deployment teams globally to align material introductions with regional deployment timelines

IP Awareness - Flag novel solutions during development for patent consideration; support IP documentation and filings using program mechanisms

Stakeholder Communication - Prepare monthly program updates, draft content for senior leadership

Travel: 10–30% - Vendor sites, labs, field trials - frequency varies by active development phase

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain -and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
3+ years of program management, product development, or material/manufacturing engineering experience
3 years experience managing vendor or supplier relationships in a technical development context
3 years demonstrating ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams through structured lifecycle gates
You must have 3+ years managing the standards of programs; reviewing all data center designs for fiber requirements, and overseeing long haul fiber deployment projects

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with fiber optic materials, OSP infrastructure, or telecommunications components
Familiarity with material testing and qualification processes (environmental cycling, mechanical stress, optical performance)
Experience with Asana, Jira, or equivalent project portfolio management tools
Understanding of supply chain dynamics (Lead times, capacity planning, multi-vendor qualification strategy)
Background working in hyperscale infrastructure environments

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE.
Happy Droid is a physical AI company dedicated to building intelligent machines that expand human capability by transforming how tasks gets done in the physical world. We develop general-purpose robotic systems that seamlessly combine mobility, perception and advanced AI to perform meaningful roles alongside people, across industries and environments.
We believe that physical AI represents the next frontier of technology, bringing intelligence beyond the digital realm and into the real world. Whether it’s solving labor shortages, augmenting productivity, alleviating safety hazards or providing personal assistance, our mission is to create safe, supportive, capable and adaptive robotic platforms which are happy to help unlock new possibilities for businesses and communities alike.

As we push the boundaries of what autonomous systems can achieve, we remain committed to developing technology that is trustworthy, human-centered, beneficial and resilient. By combining world-class engineering and a resilient supply chain with an ongoing focus on real-world impact, Happy Droid is helping to create a future where intelligent machines empower humanity to achieve a better quality of life.

ABOUT THE ROLE.
As a Senior Materials Program Manager, you will lead the strategy and execution required to ensure material readiness for next-generation physical AI robotics (and associated products) from concept through volume production. Serving as the critical link between Engineering, Supply Chain, Contract Manufacturers and Strategic Suppliers, you will develop sourcing strategies, build resilient supplier partnerships and drive end-to-end materials execution that enables successful product launches.

This highly cross-functional role combines strategic sourcing, materials program management, supplier development, contract manufacturing partnerships and supply chain optimization. You will proactively identify and mitigate supply risks, optimize product cost and ensure seamless transitions from prototype builds through mass production to enable rapid company growth.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL OWN…

Sourcing & Supplier Management

Develop and execute sourcing strategies and long-term roadmaps for critical mechanical, electrical, electromechanical and OEM components, ensuring supply resilience, scalability and competitive cost.
Drive continuous cost reduction initiatives through RFQ, negotiation, new supplier qualifications, should-cost analysis, value engineering, landed-cost analysis and contractual supply agreements.
Proactively mitigate supply chain risks including single-source dependencies, long lead-time components, capacity constraints and component obsolescence.

Contract Manufacturer Engagement

Partner with global Contract Manufacturers (CMs), supporting their evolution from prototype, pilot and into high-volume production.
Own material readiness for production ramp planning and coordinate with sub-tier critical component suppliers to ensure successful product launches.
Facilitate make/buy analyses, cost model negotiations, production readiness, capacity planning, inventory strategy and operational execution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Engineering throughout the product lifecycle to influence component selection, sourcing decisions and product cost targets.
Lead material planning activities supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), product transitions and production ramp.
Communicate material readiness, supplier status, risks and mitigation plans to executive leadership while driving alignment across cross-functional stakeholders.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE, IF YOU…

Enjoy building supplier partnerships and solving supply chain challenges in fast-paced hardware development environments.
Excel at influencing cross-functional teams and bringing alignment across organizations.
Naturally balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, moving seamlessly between executive planning and day-to-day program management.
Are highly analytical and enjoy using data to drive sourcing decisions, material readiness, make/buy assessments, cost optimization and operational improvements.
Thrive in ambiguous, high-growth environments where building scalable processes and solving new challenges are part of everyday work.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations or a related discipline.
8+ years of experience in Materials Program Management, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement and/or Supply Chains supporting hardware products.
Familiarity with motors, batteries, sensors, precision mechanical components, PCBAs, and/or electronics manufacturing. 
Strong background supporting materials readiness throughout the full product lifecycle from proof-of-concept, NPI prototype builds, engineering validations and into mass production.
Proven expertise selecting, developing and managing strategic supplier and/or Contract Manufacturer relationships and; subsequently managing BOM costs, performing make/buy analyses, benchmarking cost models and driving cost reduction initiatives.
Demonstrated skills with interpreting, writing and negotiating supplier contracts and agreements (MPA, MSA, SOW, etc.)
Experience identifying and mitigating supply chain risks including long lead-time components, supplier capacity and component lifecycle management.
Analytical capabilities using ERP, MRP, PLM and any supply chain planning systems to support data-driven decision making.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive leadership.

NICE TO HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:

MBA or advanced degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations or a related discipline.
Background in robotics, autonomous systems, drones, automotive, aerospace, industrial automation or other complex precision electromechanical hardware industries.
Exposure to managing global supply chains across North America and Southeast Asia.
Knowledge around Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), Design for Testability (DFT), Design for Reliability (DFR) and Value Engineering principles.
Experience supporting rapidly scaling startups or high-volume manufacturing organizations.

Responsibilities

About the Team
The Platform Trust & Experience (PTE) team, operating under TikTok LIVE, is the dedicated central hub for all USDS Risk Control and Service efforts. Our overarching vision is to best serve our users by providing a safe and fulfilling user experience that allows them to thrive on LIVE. Our core mission is to be the cornerstone that builds trust, enhances experience, assures safety, and improves efficiency for everyone, users, creators, and agencies alike. We operate as a pivotal global communication hub, strategically focused across three critical areas: Risk, Host Creator, and Paid User, making sure every facet of the LIVE experience is protected.
To fulfill this mission and uphold LIVE's value, the PTE team proactively collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure strategic organizational alignment and efficiency, improve compliance efficiency, and mitigate various compliance risks that could impact the platform's stability.

Furthermore, we are dedicated to building a positive brand and elevating the user journey, providing pleasant service, and setting up critical policies that safeguard the entire community. Joining the PTE team means taking on a high-impact role essential for the continued success and growth of the TikTok LIVE community.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the central nervous system for risk reporting, collaborating with Legal, Finance, Payment and Operations, to ensure a unified approach to mitigation.
- Proactive Mitigation: Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on emerging threats and historical "near-misses" to prevent recurrence.
- Data-driven Reporting & Analysis: Synthesize complex risk and operational data into clear dashboards and executive-ready reports (e.g., weekly/monthly business reviews) that highlight key trends, anomalies, and root-cause insights, translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Change Management: Drive organizational adoption of new control processes, ensuring compliance isn't just a "check-the-box" activity but a core operational value.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.

The IPP team designs and builds high-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single-threaded owner for end-to-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.

Role

We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:

Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
This is a high-impact, high-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.

This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.

Identify and resolve ambiguity across organizational boundaries — scoping problems, proposing solutions, and driving alignment where no playbook exists.

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft-focussed Delivery Lead
to lead system integration projects from mobilisation through completion. The role is accountable for client outcomes, delivery performance, commercial control and stakeholder confidence across projects involving multidisciplinary, distributed and third-party teams.

The ideal candidate is a consulting-focused delivery professional with strong general project and program delivery skills. They will combine structured governance with practical leadership, sound commercial judgement and the ability to manage scope, contracts, financials, risk, quality and client expectations. Experience delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM or ERP solutions is desirable but not essential.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery Leadership

Own delivery outcomes across scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, dependencies and benefits.
Mobilise engagements by translating contractual commitments into an integrated delivery plan, governance model, resource plan and delivery controls.
Establish clear roles, decision rights, escalation paths, milestones, acceptance criteria and reporting expectations.
Lead Agile, Hybrid or Waterfall delivery approaches appropriate to the engagement.
Maintain an integrated view of workstreams, critical path, dependencies, client obligations and delivery readiness.
Drive timely decisions, resolve delivery blockers and intervene early when performance varies from plan.
Lead delivery through discovery, design, build, test, deployment, transition and closure, as applicable.
Ensure lessons learned, handover activities and closure obligations are completed.

Project Management

Build trusted client relationships and act as the principal delivery contact for senior stakeholders.
Facilitate discovery workshops, governance forums, steering committees, planning sessions and executive reviews.
Translate business objectives and consulting recommendations into achievable delivery outcomes.
Provide clear, evidence-based advice on priorities, trade-offs, delivery options and impacts.
Challenge assumptions constructively and help clients make informed decisions.
Align business, functional and technical stakeholders around scope, outcomes and delivery priorities.
Communicate complex delivery matters clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to improve client outcomes, extend value or support follow-on work without compromising current delivery commitments.
Manage difficult conversations professionally, including delays, scope pressure, quality concerns and unmet client obligations.

Contract Management

Review and understand the contract, Statement of Work, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, deliverables, acceptance criteria and client obligations.
Translate contractual commitments into delivery controls, work plans and traceable acceptance arrangements.
Maintain alignment between contracted scope, the delivery backlog, solution design, schedule, resourcing and financial forecasts.
Monitor client and supplier obligations and address late, incomplete or changed inputs before they affect delivery.
Identify scope gaps, ambiguity, relief events and contractual risks early and escalate them appropriately.
Lead change control by assessing impacts to scope, schedule, cost, resources, quality and benefits.
Prepare change requests and support commercial negotiations with account, legal and commercial stakeholders.
Prevent uncontrolled scope growth and ensure additional effort is formally assessed and approved before commitment.
Manage deliverable submission, review, acceptance, rejection and remediation in accordance with the contract.
Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence to support contractual and commercial decisions.

Commercial Management

Own project budgets, forecasts, revenue, cost, margin and financial performance.
Monitor sold-versus-delivered performance, burn rate, effort, resource utilisation and estimate-to-complete.
Reconcile the delivery plan, staffing model and financial forecast regularly.
Identify margin erosion, unplanned effort or forecast variance early and implement corrective action.
Validate time, expenses, milestones and invoicing inputs.
Work with account and commercial leaders to manage contractual exposure, change requests and recovery plans.
Balance customer outcomes with responsible commercial decision-making.
Contribute to proposals, estimates, delivery models, Statements of Work and pre-sales reviews.
Support delivery readiness and solution-to-delivery handover before commitments are made to clients.

Governance

Establish fit-for-purpose governance that supports timely decisions rather than administrative reporting.
Maintain and actively manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions and actions.
Produce concise status reporting focused on outcomes, variance, decisions, customer impact and required intervention.
Escalate bad news early, with clear facts, impacts, options and recommendations.
Define quality gates, review points and acceptance evidence across the lifecycle.
Ensure deliverables meet contractual requirements, agreed acceptance criteria and professional quality standards.
Coordinate independent assurance or quality reviews where required and drive resulting corrective actions.
Maintain delivery compliance with organisational methods, policies, security requirements and client governance.
Protect delivery evidence, approvals and decision records.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary delivery interface for client sponsors, executives and governance forums.
Set and manage realistic expectations regarding scope, timing, cost, quality and client dependencies.
Build alignment across client, account, practice, vendor and delivery stakeholders.
Prepare and lead steering committee discussions, presenting a clear view of status, decisions, risks and recovery actions.
Tailor communications to executive, business, functional and technical audiences.
Maintain stakeholder confidence through transparency, consistency and follow-through.
Manage escalations calmly and coordinate an agreed response across the engagement leadership team.

Team and Resource Leadership

Lead cross-functional teams including architects, consultants, developers, engineers, business analysts, testers, change specialists and project support.
Coordinate onshore, offshore, nearshore, client and third-party contributors.
Establish team ways of working, delivery rhythms, accountability and collaboration expectations.
Manage resource demand, capacity, onboarding, performance and role clarity.
Create an inclusive environment where risks and concerns can be raised early.
Coach workstream leads and project team members in delivery disciplines and client engagement.
Hold individuals and teams accountable for commitments while supporting resolution of impediments.
Promote continuous improvement, reusable assets and efficient delivery practices.

Business Applications Delivery

The Delivery Lead may lead engagements involving enterprise business applications, integration, data, cloud, security, workplace or digital transformation solutions.

Experience With The Following Is Desirable

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement / CRM.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations / ERP.
Power Platform, Dataverse and Power BI.
Business process transformation, fit-gap analysis and requirements traceability.
Data migration, integration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare.
Azure DevOps or comparable backlog and work-management tooling.
Multi-vendor or systems-integration programs.

The Delivery Lead is not expected to be the solution architect but must be able to understand delivery implications, challenge plans and facilitate informed decisions with functional and technical leaders.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Experience

Significant experience leading enterprise consulting, technology or business transformation engagements.
Demonstrated accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality and client outcomes.
Strong understanding of consulting delivery, governance and professional services environments.
Experience managing contracts, Statements of Work, deliverables, assumptions, client obligations and change control.
Strong commercial and financial management capability, including forecasting, margin management and estimate-to-complete.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and distributed teams.
Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation and executive communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, resolve conflict and recover challenged delivery.
Working knowledge of Agile, Hybrid and Waterfall delivery approaches.
Experience with enterprise project planning, RAID management, resource management and governance reporting.
Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear executive-level materials.

Desirable Experience

Delivery experience across Microsoft technology or enterprise business applications.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM / Customer Engagement implementation experience.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations / ERP implementation experience.
Experience delivering Power Platform, data, integration or cloud-enabled transformation.
Experience working for a consulting organisation, systems integrator or Microsoft partner.
Experience with complex fixed-price, time-and-materials or outcome-based engagements.
Experience supporting proposals, estimates, solution reviews and pre-sales activities.
Experience managing third-party vendors, offshore teams or multi-partner delivery models.

PMP.
PRINCE2 Practitioner.
Certified ScrumMaster or equivalent Agile certification.
PMI-ACP or equivalent.
ITIL Foundation or higher.
Relevant delivery leadership or professional services certification.

Microsoft

Microsoft certifications are desirable rather than mandatory and may include:

Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (CRM).

Other role-relevant Microsoft certifications.
